name: Hanoi to Sapa Private Transfer
highway: Noi Bai - Lao Cai Expressway (CT05) & Mong Sen Viaduct
description: Direct, private door-to-door transfer from Hanoi Old Quarter or Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) to Sapa town. Travel smoothly via the 245 km Noi Bai – Lao Cai Expressway (CT05) and ascend via the newly opened Mong Sen Viaduct—the tallest highway viaduct in Vietnam—completely bypassing the hazardous hairpin curves of old National Highway 4D.
highlights: 100% via CT05 Expressway and Mong Sen Viaduct with all tolls included
Door-to-door hotel drop-off in Sapa Town, Fansipan Cable Car, or valley resorts
Midpoint rest stop at Km117 (Tan Quy, Yen Bai) for hot pho, coffee, and restrooms
Mountain-certified chauffeurs with 5+ years experience on high-altitude passes
Flexible departure timing avoiding early train transfers or cramped sleeper buses

steps.label: 1. Hotel / Airport Pickup
steps.text: Your dedicated chauffeur greets you at your hotel lobby in Hanoi Old Quarter, West Lake, or arrival gate at Noi Bai Airport with a name sign and assists with luggage.

steps.label: 2. CT05 Expressway Cruise
steps.text: Depart the city onto the 4-lane Noi Bai – Lao Cai Expressway (CT05), traveling smoothly across the flat Red River Delta plain through Vinh Phuc and Phu Tho provinces.

steps.label: 3. Midpoint Rest Stop at Km117
steps.text: Enjoy an optional 15-to-20-minute comfort break at Tan Quy Station (Km117 Yen Bai) featuring clean restrooms, authentic hot Vietnamese noodle soup, iced coffee, and fresh tropical fruit.

steps.label: 4. Lao Cai Border Gate Footprint
steps.text: Pass through Lao Cai city near the border with Yunnan, approaching the dramatic foothills of the Hoang Lien Son mountain range.

steps.label: 5. Scenic Ascent via Mong Sen Viaduct
steps.text: Cross the newly constructed 612-meter Mong Sen Viaduct towering up to 83 meters above the valley floor. Soak in sweeping views of cascading terraced rice paddies before reaching your hotel entrance in Sapa.

sections.title: Hotel Drop-off & Mountain Travel Advice
items: Town Center Hotels: Direct drop-off at Hotel de la Coupole - MGallery, Sun Plaza, Sapa Stone Church, Pistachio Hotel, and Cau May street accommodations.
Resorts Outside Town: Seamless drop-off at Silk Path Grand Resort & Spa, Pao's Sapa Leisure Hotel, and Ville De Mont Mountain Resort.

Topas Ecolodge & Deep Valley Homestays: Located in Ban Lach (~18 km south of Sapa), roads are narrow and steep. A private 7-seat SUV or 16-seat van is strongly recommended for direct lodge gate drop-off.
Fansipan Cable Car Station: Your chauffeur can drop your group directly at the Sun World Fansipan Legend cable car terminal upon arrival if you wish to start your ascent immediately.

Mountain-Certified Drivers: Every chauffeur assigned to Sapa has at least 5 years of mountain pass driving experience, certified defensive driving training, and strictly adheres to mountain speed limits.
Ample Luggage Capacity: Plenty of trunk room for oversized trekking backpacks, winter coats, and walking poles.

steps.label: 1. Morning Hotel Pickup
steps.text: Your chauffeur arrives at your Hanoi Old Quarter or West Lake hotel lobby at your scheduled time (typically 8:00 AM – 8:30 AM) with luggage loading assistance.

steps.label: 2. CT04 Expressway High-Speed Cruise
steps.text: Glide along the modern 6-lane CT04 expressway cruising smoothly at 100–120 km/h, bypassing regional freight traffic.

steps.label: 3. Optional Comfort Stop at V52
steps.text: Optional 15-minute break at the modern Hai Duong V52 rest stop featuring clean western restrooms, Highlands Coffee, ATMs, and local delicacies.

steps.label: 4. Bach Dang Cable-Stayed Bridge
steps.text: Cross the multi-span Bach Dang Bridge connecting Hai Phong and Quang Ninh over the Cam River estuary.

steps.label: 5. Port Terminal Arrival & Meet Chauffeur
steps.text: Direct curbside drop-off right at your designated cruise check-in lounge or marina ticket counter before 11:30 AM. For return trips, your driver awaits inside the port arrivals lounge with a personalized name placard as you disembark.

sections.title: Ha Long Cruise Port Terminal Guide
items: Tuan Chau International Marina: Hub for Paradise Vietnam, Bhaya Cruises, Ambassador Day Cruise, Pelican Cruises, and Genesis Day Tours.

Ha Long International Cruise Port (Sun Port, Bai Chay): Modern deep-water passenger terminal for premier overnight lines including Ambassador Overnight, Heritage Binh Chuan, Indochine, Grand Pioneers (Essence Grand), and Elite of the Seas.
Hon Gai / Vinashin Dock: Departure pier for boutique Bai Tu Long Bay itineraries (Swan Cruises, Dragon Legend).
Got Ferry / Dong Bai Ferry Wharf: Dedicated transfer link if you are taking the high-speed ferry across to Cat Ba Island.
Noi Bai Airport Flight Tracking: If landing at HAN, send us your flight number; dispatchers track incoming flights live and adjust pickup seamlessly in case of baggage or customs delays.
All Highway Tolls Included: All CT04 and CT06 ETC electronic toll charges (~280,000 VND) and port parking permits are 100% pre-paid.
